description: A Perl script that converts a binary image into S-record format. It reads a binary input file, transforms the data into S-record lines with specified address offsets, and writes the output. The script defines a function for S-record line generation and handles file I/O and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: srec
methods.description: Generates a single line of S-record format based on provided type, address, data, and length.
